name: Infra: Serilog run log with provider traffic
description:
Serilog writes the existing `--log <PATH>` run log, and the log records provider traffic in detail for debugging a run. Terms: docs show infra-cli/glossary (provider, provider traffic).

- Serilog (Serilog.Sinks.File + CompactJsonFormatter, CLEF) replaces InfraLog's hand-rolled JSONL writer. No new option. InfraLog keeps its API and Spectre console output; -v/-vv only affect the console. The file records everything (Debug and traffic) regardless of -v.
- Appends across runs; every event carries RunId, Command, Env, EventName.
- Provider traffic: cloud HTTP (DigitalOcean, Cloudflare, Spaces), registry HTTP (one DelegatingHandler, also wired into RegistryClient), SSH commands (command, exit code, stdout, stderr), local processes (args, exit code, output). Every poll is logged.
- Two events per call: provider.request before sending, provider.response or provider.failed after, sharing RequestId. Structured Provider, method, URL, status, DurationMs.
- Bodies as exact text after redaction, capped at 64 KB with the full length noted; binary bodies as content type and length only.
- Redaction: credential headers (Authorization, Cookie, X-Amz-Security-Token, signatures) always (secret); bodies and output through SecretRedactor; credential-named JSON properties (password, token, private_key, secret, uri/connection_string) replaced; process environment variables by name only.
- Tests (NUnit): ValidateCommandTests and InfraLogTests move to CLEF; fake handler tests for redaction and request/response pairing.
- After: update docs infra-cli/commands (--log).
author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>

comments.author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>
comments.text: Built: Serilog CLEF writer behind InfraLog (RunId/Command/Env/EventName), TrafficCall request/response pairs, TrafficHandler on cloud and registry HttpClients, ProcessRunner and db copy docker processes, HostSession ssh traffic; redaction per the issue. Tests: InfraLogTests, ValidateCommandTests moved to CLEF; new ProviderTrafficTests and HostSession traffic tests (459 infra tests pass). Renamed event fields env->evaluatedEnv (evaluate.done) and command->script (host.command) to avoid clashing with enriched Env/Command. Not covered: Npgsql connections, SSH port forwards. Docs: infra-cli/run-log, infra-cli/commands.
